name: drawing-to-3d
description: Turn an engineering drawing (photo, scan, PDF or DXF; Russian ESKD/GOST or ISO/ASME) into a precise 3D model (STEP + STL) through generated CadQuery code that runs on your own PC, then verify the model against the drawing. Five deterministic stdlib scripts: a part-spec validator that gates the drawing readout and refuses to proceed while any dimension is still an open question; a CadQuery code generator that emits one runnable script where every feature carries its drawing callout id and the script measures what it built; a model verifier that checks validity, overall size, every hole diameter, title-block mass and thread callouts against the drawing (PASS/FAIL); an ASCII DXF geometry extractor that reads exact holes, radii, dimensions and notes; and a self-contained HTML STL viewer with drawing-standard views. Ships the cs-cad-modeler agent and the /cs:drawing-to-3d and /cs:cad-verify commands.
